page: Microsoft Azure NV24ads_V710_v5 is a virtual machine instance from the NVadsV710v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 5.33 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes a single V710 GPU with 22 GB of dedicated VRAM, alongside a local storage volume of 1649 GB delivered via NVMe SSD. The instance is also Premium Storage capable but does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance bundles dedicated compute, local NVMe storage, and GPU acceleration into a single resource profile. This dense hardware integration reduces the need for external storage attachments for workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space. The combination of 24 dedicated vCPUs, 128.0 GB of RAM, and a 22 GB VRAM GPU makes this server type appropriate for virtual desktop infrastructure, hardware-accelerated graphics rendering, and moderate machine learning inference or data processing tasks.
